subject: Question about the cleanup timeline
text: When you have a moment, could you share feedback on the revised block cleanup timeline I posted after our last call? I noticed the notes said 'finalize vendor details,' and I wanted to check whether that meant selecting the caterer, confirming the delivery window, or both. I made the first change assuming it was only the vendor list, but I could easily adjust it before it circulates. I don't want to guess and slow anyone down, especially with the approval meeting approaching. If it's easier, a short reply like 'keep going as planned' or 'please split the vendor and logistics rows' would help me stay aligned. Happy to walk through it later today too.
